# EclipseOS live/install medium package set (D-03 §2).
#
# Two jobs, deliberately not separated: this list is both what the live medium
# boots with and what `install-eclipseos.sh` pacstraps onto the target. Keeping
# one list means the thing you tried on the live ISO is the thing you installed.

## boot and kernel (D-01 §2)
linux
linux-firmware
linux-firmware-amdgpu
amd-ucode
mkinitcpio
base
# Limine rather than systemd-boot: a Framework 13 refused systemd-boot's stub
# outright, and an unbootable internal disk is a worse place to find that out
# than a USB stick. install-eclipseos.sh copies its stub to the ESP by hand.
limine
efibootmgr

## filesystem and disk tools the installer needs
e2fsprogs
dosfstools
exfatprogs
btrfs-progs
xfsprogs
gptfdisk
parted
cryptsetup
lvm2
mdadm
arch-install-scripts

## base userland
sudo
which
less
nano
micro
man-db
man-pages
usbutils
pciutils
lsof
htop
rsync
wget
curl
git
openssh
zsh

## graphics stack (D-01 §1) — amdgpu is in-kernel, no DKMS
mesa
vulkan-radeon
libva-mesa-driver
libdrm
libdisplay-info
libxkbcommon
wayland
wayland-utils
seatd
libinput

## services the DE consumes over D-Bus (D-01 §1)
networkmanager
bluez
bluez-utils
upower
pipewire
pipewire-pulse
pipewire-alsa
wireplumber
alsa-utils
polkit

## greeter and session (D-01 §3)
greetd
greetd-regreet
cage
foot
xdg-user-dirs
xdg-utils
noto-fonts
noto-fonts-emoji
ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd

## EclipseOS itself (D-01 §1) — pulls abyss, desktop and policyd
eclipseos-meta

# NetworkManager runs on iwd here so the live medium's saved wifi carries over.
iwd
